visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed photo hero with overlaid headline, subheading and a single CTA
visualCharacteristics.layout: background image fills the block; text stacked top-left on mobile, vertically centred on desktop

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image; row 2: H1 title, subheading paragraph, CTA link (one row with image + text in one cell also works)
contentPattern.sourceDescription: Background photo with H1 "The moment you realise", subheading paragraph and one CTA link "Life, Made Lighter"

usage: Top-of-page hero on the home page.
reuseGuidance: Use for any page-opening banner with a photo behind the headline. Use plain hero for text-only banners.
